mapper.sql: id, course_code, name, course_type, credit, weekly_periods, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
select from course
and course_code like concat('%', #{courseCode}, '%')
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and course_type = #{courseType}
order by course_code
mapper.insert: insert into course (course_code, name, course_type, credit, weekly_periods, create_time, update_time) values (#{courseCode}, #{name}, #{courseType}, #{credit}, #{weeklyPeriods}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update course set course_code = #{courseCode}, name = #{name}, course_type = #{courseType}, credit = #{credit}, weekly_periods = #{weeklyPeriods}, update_time = #{updateTime} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from course_offering where course_id = #{id}
